At base 9725f16 exactly five tests executed it, all through rr.provider(<id>).<extra>: test_private_provider_handle_has_no_removed_declaration_methods, test_pl_imgw_handle_has_no_cache_controls[cache_status], test_pl_imgw_handle_has_no_cache_controls[refresh_cache], test_cache_carve_out_handle_contracts_are_explicit and test_ca_eccc_cache_lifecycle_remains_reachable. Only the CALL SITE rr.provider(...) was withdrawn; the SUBJECT was ordered to survive. The plan therefore simultaneously mandated keeping the function and removed every check that constrains it, without requiring the assertions to be re-pinned on the surviving internal runtime _registry.get(<id>) - which is exactly the re-pin it did require, and got, for the observation and catalogue methods of the same class (test_public_observations_* -> test_registry_observations_*, test_provider_handle_info/catalogue_* -> test_registered_runtime_*). __getattr__ was the one method of _ProviderHandle left out of that rename list. def test_registered_runtime_forwards_extras_and_rejects_unknown_attributes(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    class FakeHydatClient:
        def cache_status(self) -> str:
            return "cache-status"

        def refresh_cache(self) -> list[str]:
            return ["cache-refresh"]

    monkeypatch.setattr(ca_eccc_module, "HydatClient", FakeHydatClient)
    rr.providers()
    handle = _registry.get("ca_eccc")

    assert handle.cache_status() == "cache-status"
    assert handle.refresh_cache() == ["cache-refresh"]
    assert not hasattr(_registry.get("pl_imgw"), "cache_status")
    assert not hasattr(handle, "row_" + "annotation_schema")

with `from rivretrieve._internal.providers.ca_eccc import module as ca_eccc_module` added to that file's imports (rr, _registry and pytest are already imported there). This retains, byte-for-byte, the exact expected values of all four withdrawn base assertions - "cache-status" and ["cache-refresh"] from test_ca_eccc_cache_lifecycle_remains_reachable, the pl_imgw absence from test_pl_imgw_handle_has_no_cache_controls / test_cache_carve_out_handle_contracts_are_explicit, and the split-literal removed-declaration probe from test_private_provider_handle_has_no_removed_declaration_methods - and changes only the access path from the withdrawn rr.provider(<id>) to the surviving _registry.get(<id>), which is the same substitution the plan already mandates for test_registry_observations_* and test_registered_runtime_*.
